name: Track new Greenhouse jobs by filters with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Track filtered Greenhouse jobs in Google Sheets

Build a shortlist of roles from companies you follow. This workflow helps job seekers and recruiters monitor public Greenhouse boards using company, keyword, department, location and remote filters. It requires no AI service or applicant data.

### How it works
The workflow starts one Apify run and waits for that same run. Complete coverage, dataset counts and estimated Actor charges must reconcile before delivery. Each job uses one stable Sheet key per watch scope. The first run labels matching jobs NEW, even when originally published earlier. Repeats update existing rows, add newly observed matches, and mark confirmed CLOSED or LEFT_FILTER jobs. Unchanged jobs remain billable. The Sheet is a current register; change labels describe the latest observation, not permanent event history. Incomplete or capped checks stop without writing. Verified empty results produce no new rows.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify Header Auth credential: name Authorization, value Bearer followed by your token. Select it on all four HTTP nodes.
2. Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on the delivery node. Create a Greenhouse Watch tab with the supplied CSV headers.
3. Enter the spreadsheet ID in Job watch settings. Start with the default Airbnb remote engineering example, then change filters as needed.
4. Run manually and inspect the Sheet. Keep the watch name and filters stable and run sequentially; changed settings create a new scope.
5. Up to three boards and 100 matching jobs are supported. The default $1 charge cap is a limit, not a quoted run price. Apify usage is paid; the template includes no credits.

## 1. Configure
Set company boards, job filters and your Sheet destination. Validation stops missing destinations and invalid caps before paid work.

## 2. Run once and wait
Only the first HTTP call starts an Actor. Polling reads the existing run; failures stop before any Sheet write.

## 3. Verify output
Read the authoritative summary and the complete bounded dataset. Reject incomplete coverage or row-count mismatches.

## 4. Update your register
One stable key per job and watch scope. Keep confirmed closures as rows. Only destination delivery may retry; the paid Actor never retries automatically.
